back: High birth rate and high, fluctuating death rate: little growth.
High birth rate, rapidly falling death rate: natural increase and population growth are fastest.
Birth rate falls (contraception, education, urbanisation), death rate low: growth slows.
Stage 4: low birth and death rates, stable population. Stage 5 (optional): birth rate below death rate, population falls without immigration.

front: What does a wide base on a pyramid show?
back: A high birth rate: a youthful, expanding population.
Based on Europe; ignores migration, HIV/AIDS and policy; assumes all countries follow one path; stage 5 uncertain.
Rising pension and health costs, a shrinking workforce and tax base, labour shortages.
Pressure on schools, clinics, food, housing and jobs; a possible demographic dividend if jobs are created.
